name: Vizard
tagline: Turns long videos into short, captioned clips for social in one click.
description: Vizard is an AI video tool that automatically slices long-form videos — podcasts, webinars, interviews, livestreams — into short, social-ready vertical clips. It transcribes the source, finds the highlight moments, adds auto-captions, and reframes to keep the speaker centered for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. A free plan lets you try clipping without signing up, with paid Creator and Business tiers for more exports and longer videos.
edge: Turns one long video into dozens of captioned vertical clips with speaker-tracking reframe, and lets you try it free with no signup.
